item.title: Indie Brief, Wednesday 30 September
item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Wednesday 30 September.
Modern Times Review reports on Inconvenient Films, the Baltic region's only human rights documentary festival, which is marking twenty years of operation.
